thread:
Vanderbilt has more restaurants within a 10-minute walk of campus than UT Chattanooga, Memphis and Tennessee combined.

Every Tennessee university with 10,000+ students:

1. Vanderbilt: 129
2. UT Chattanooga: 28
3. Memphis: 26
4. Tennessee: 21
5. East Tennessee State: 18
6. Middle Tennessee State: 9

Places to eat within half a mile of each campus's center, using Overture Maps listings.

Look up any campus, with the closest places first: https://www.savorscout.net/campus/tn

UC Berkeley has more restaurants within a mile of campus than UCLA, UC Davis and UC Riverside combined.

All 9 UC campuses:

1. UC Berkeley: 428
2. UCLA: 164
3. UC Davis: 149
4. UC Riverside: 100
5. UC San Diego: 84
6. UC Irvine: 55
7. UC Merced: 42
8. UC Santa Barbara: 38
9. UC Santa Cruz: 21

Places to eat within a mile of each campus's center, using Overture Maps listings.

Look up any campus, with the closest places first: https://www.savorscout.net/rankings/university-of-california/
